text: Alla seniiɗo On waɗanii on e cuuɗi mon ɗi mahirton kaaƴe ekn ñiiɓirde e fowtorde mon. O waɗani on kadi e guri gelooɗi ɗin e na'i ɗin e dammi ɗin tillisaaji cuuroy ka ladde, wano cuuɗi saare, hoyɗi ronndagol ka setagol mon yaha nokku goo, welɗi femmpude ka jipporɗe mon. O waɗani on kadi e leeɓi baali ɗin, e leeɓi gelooɗi ɗin, e leeɓi dammi ɗin ndaɗɗudi cuuɗi mon, e conci e cuddaa- je ɗe dakmitorton haa dumunna happpaaɗo.
